request.name: dry_multiplier
request.description: DRY repetition penalty multiplier; 0 disables DRY sampling.

request.description: Base of the exponential penalty growth for repeated sequences.

request.name: dry_allowed_length
request.description: Number of tokens that may repeat before the penalty applies.

request.name: dry_penalty_last_n
request.description: Window of recent tokens considered by the DRY penalty.

request.name: stream
request.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.
